title: Route subagent counts by worktree branch; overlaps to the sprint line
goal: kbusage reads a subagent transcript's work/<id> branch in memory and distill adds its counts to that item's line; a main-session prompt inside two windows counts once on the line of their sprint.
notes: Scope widened: a routed subagent gives an item line prompts 0 and no main, which ql_store.work_line_problems rejects; the work sidecar bullets in querylog.md describe the old overlap rule.
